::: {#def-group-action}
## Group action

A *group action* of a group $G$ on a set $X$ is a map
$G \times X \longrightarrow X$, written $(g,x) \mapsto g \cdot x$, such that
$e \cdot x=x$ and $(gh) \cdot x=g \cdot(h \cdot x)$ for every
$g,h \in G$ and $x \in X$.

This definition is a shared include. Its containing-page anchor is observed
separately on each rendered page.
:::
